name: Linux Reverse Path Filter All Interfaces
description:
Ensures net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter is 1 (strict) or 2 (loose), so packets with source addresses that are not routable back through the receiving interface are dropped. The remedy applies loose mode, which is safe for multi-homed hosts with asymmetric routing.
Required sudo rule (remedy only): allow user lea to run ONLY this exact command without a password: lea ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /sbin/sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=2
